tools.name: get_trust_manifest
tools.description: Free, read-only entry point. Call this first when deciding whether Agent Transaction Trust fits an x402 purchase. Returns capabilities, supported authority modes, proof key, price/network information, and the endpoints needed for transaction clearance, authorization, and settlement verification.

tools.name: create_ap2_challenge
tools.description: Free prerequisite for AP2-native transaction clearance or authorization. Call before clearance_x402_ap2 or authorize_x402_ap2, bind the returned challenge into the AP2 Payment Mandate proof, then pass that challenge token as ap2_authority.challenge_token. tools.name: verify_trust_token
tools.description: Free, read-only token check. Use this to validate the signature and expiry of a Trust policy, authorization token, transaction clearance token, or settlement receipt; it does not perform on-chain settlement verification.

tools.name: verify_settlement
tools.description: Free post-payment step. Call only after the merchant x402 payment for a previously approved authorization or transaction clearance. Verifies the Base USDC settlement on-chain and, when it matches the authorization, returns a signed settlement receipt. The authorization_token may come from clearance_

tools.name: preflight_x402
tools.description: Paid public preflight for an autonomous x402 payment. No account, API key, policy token, or AP2 mandate is required. Submit the merchant's real PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and the exact intended HTTP request. Returns preflight_decision APPROVED, REVIEW or DENIED plus a signed preflight_token. APPROVE

tools.description: Paid transaction-clearance decision for an autonomous x402 purchase.
